extension.description: Reviews seatbelt commands that remove or weaken the guardrail it installs for coding agents: removing its hook, installing it so a crashing hook fails open, and editing agent settings.
extension.name: seatbelt-guard command protection

permissions.description: Identifies `seatbelt uninstall <agent> --write`, which removes seatbelt's PreToolUse hook from an agent's settings and turns the guardrail off. Without --write the command only previews the change. xargs launches are blocked by Guard's wrapper floor.
permissions.label: seatbelt hook removal
safer_guidance: Preview with `seatbelt uninstall <agent>` (no --write) before removing the hook.
Do not let the agent that seatbelt guards remove its own guardrail.

permissions.description: Identifies `seatbelt install <agent> --no-on-failure-block --write`, which installs the hook without `onFailure: block`, so a crash or timeout of the hook lets every command run unchecked. xargs launches are blocked by Guard's wrapper floor.
permissions.label: seatbelt fail-open install
safer_guidance: Keep the default `onFailure: block` so a failing hook cannot silently allow commands.
Run `seatbelt doctor` after any change to the hook.

permissions.description: Identifies `seatbelt install <agent> --write`, which edits an agent's settings file (user, project or local scope) to add the seatbelt hook. A backup is kept, but the file changes. xargs launches are blocked by Guard's wrapper floor.
permissions.label: seatbelt agent settings change
safer_guidance: Check the settings diff, then run `seatbelt doctor`.

rules.description: Identifies `seatbelt uninstall <agent> --write`, which removes seatbelt's PreToolUse hook from an agent's settings and turns the guardrail off. Without --write the command only previews the change. xargs launches are blocked by Guard's wrapper floor.
safer_alternatives: Run `seatbelt uninstall <agent>` without --write to preview the change first.
Remove the hook yourself, in a terminal the agent does not control, if you really mean to turn the guardrail off.
rules.title: seatbelt hook removal

rules.description: Identifies `seatbelt install <agent> --no-on-failure-block --write`, which installs the hook without `onFailure: block`, so a crash or timeout of the hook lets every command run unchecked. xargs launches are blocked by Guard's wrapper floor.

safe_variants.title: seatbelt install without fail-closed hook help

safer_alternatives: Install without --no-on-failure-block so a broken hook blocks instead of allowing.
Run `seatbelt doctor` afterwards to prove the installed hook really works.
rules.title: seatbelt install without fail-closed hook

rules.description: Identifies `seatbelt install <agent> --write`, which edits an agent's settings file (user, project or local scope) to add the seatbelt hook. A backup is kept, but the file changes. xargs launches are blocked by Guard's wrapper floor.
safer_alternatives: Run `seatbelt install <agent>` without --write to preview the exact change.
Review the settings file diff and the `.bak` copy after installing.
rules.title: seatbelt agent settings change

safer_alternatives: Preview `seatbelt install` and `seatbelt uninstall` without --write first.
Keep the default fail-closed hook and run `seatbelt doctor` after any change.
